item.text:
The test does not exercise a parser. [parser_test.cc](/sanitized/tmp/google-dev-standards-retest.root-04/codex/N3-googletest-cpp/workspace/parser_test.cc:9) only checks that the fixture’s hard-coded string is nonempty, so it would pass even if parsing were broken or absent.

Replace that assertion with a call to the parser and check the result: for example, verify that `"alpha,beta"` produces exactly two fields, in order, with values `"alpha"` and `"beta"`. If parsing can fail, assert success before inspecting the fields.

The fixture’s `std::string` is instance state, so GoogleTest gives each test a fresh copy; there is no isolation issue visible here. With only one test, the input could instead be local to the test. Add cases for empty input, empty fields, and malformed input as appropriate to the parser’s documented contract.

No parser implementation or contract is present in the workspace, so the exact API and expected edge-case behavior cannot be verified. No files were modified.
